description: A scheduled maintenance page block for Svelte 5: what is changing, a live countdown to the expected finish time, an SvProgress bar and a step list that advance with the clock, a notify-me SvTextInput that checks the email format before the SvButton submits, and a status link. The interval is cleared in the $effect teardown.

faq.question: How does the countdown stay live without leaking timers?
faq.answer: An $effect inside createMaintenance starts a one-second setInterval that updates now and returns a function that clears it, so the interval stops when the block unmounts. The countdown, progress and current step are all $derived from now.

faq.question: How do I set the real maintenance window?
faq.answer: Pass startsAt and endsAt as millisecond timestamps. By default the window started 26 minutes ago and ends in 19. When the end passes the clock reads Any minute now.

faq.question: How does the notify-me field validate?
faq.answer: On submit the email is checked against a simple pattern; a bad value sets the SvTextInput error. A valid one shows loading on the button, then a success toast and a confirmation line in place of the form.
